Name: Eggs Mayo and Cheese Expansion
Author: BasiliskL
Description:
Makes all egg laying farm animals lay a large and small egg specific to them and adds a mayo version for blue, gold, and ostrich eggs as well as 8 other egg items in the game.

Adds a dairy free cheese item made in the cheese press from cauliflower, coconut, oil, potato, or rice since there's real world dairy free cheeses made from them.

Retextures white, brown, void, and duck eggs to make them uniform size (based on the golden egg since I felt that it has the best shape)

Also retextures the Large white and brown eggs to a custom texture I made that I feel looks better and is uniform size with the large eggs this mod adds

Might add more config options in the future, also let me know if there's any specific mods you want compatibility with


still no fix for large duck eggs and duck feathers, if I get to it I'll probably add a dependency with extra animal configs
